sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable f7699dd CMake clean-builds network-disabled 2 CPUs/3GiB/256 processes; original outputs passed recorded validator, CTest has no registered tests.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: main.cpp:80–93 root-loads CGNS and writes METIS partitions; mesh_io.cpp handles separate TRI_3/QUAD_4, not CGNS MIXED.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative finite-volume residual, Rusanov and wall/farfield paths exist; no independent smooth-order or shock verification.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: LSQ reconstruction, limiter and positivity fallback present; diagnostic first-order controls exist but production disabling is not established; no independent smooth-order test.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: solver.cpp:847–861 integrates complete wall traction while report.tex:152–155 explicitly claims tangential-only. Normal contribution is unquantified.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS and Newton–Krylov fallback implemented; two early laminar residual stops retain large force drifts. inner_solve:765–795 recomputes residual/gradients after each transient update; exact historical binary unbound.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Root-only CGNS preprocessing, METIS and halos; retained workspace rank studies agree closely in absolute drag, but recorded revision predates solver source and exact binaries unbound.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: M015/M2 laminar marked converged despite material final force drift. Other cases have limits; Re20 Cd2.131 plausible and Re200 St≈0.1505 with approaching late periodicity, but plots fail separate evidence floors.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: All11 accepted PDF pages inspected; report claims early M015/M2 convergence and tangential force split contradicted by source. Original checkpoint figures fill missing classes, but Re20 late force and Re200 late drag unresolved.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate case, mesh, physics, partition, solver and output modules; fixed 2-D four-variable state limits 3-D/physics extension.
